title: 第50章 你寄的这果子够劲！

第50章 你寄的这果子够劲！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

许默把结果告诉曲粒。

那边沉默了几秒，回了一个苦笑的表情包。

“你那边有其他人吗？我就说怎么周围一个人都碰不到，看来我被扔到地图边边角角了。”

“不过我能活到现在，也不是全靠运气。”

许默想了想，说：“人过不来，东西能过去。交易界面是全域的，我用交易的方式给你寄点东西，你帮我研究，你可以随便放入物品，水，纸，树叶，都随便。”

曲粒说行。

许默从储物空间里取出一枚【腐血果】。

蓝色品质，剧毒，但经处理后可做麻醉剂。

他用系统交易功能将这枚果子寄给了曲粒，附言：“小心，这玩意儿有毒，帮我看看能不能提纯出稳定的麻醉成分。”

交易框显示曲粒已收货。

大约过了半个时辰，曲粒发来消息，字里行间带着一股兴奋：“哥们，你寄的这果子够劲！我刚才用石锅试着加热萃取，结果锅炸了，厨房没了半面墙。”

许默嘴角抽了一下：“人没事吧？”

“没事，我躲得快。不过炸的时候我闻到了气味，极浓的麻醉效果，我差点当场睡过去。”

“果子在高温下会释放强效迷幻成分，但同时也极不稳定。如果能找到一个能承受高压的密闭容器，把果肉在容器内高温加热，让气体无法逃逸，应该能大量提纯成液体麻醉剂。普通的陶罐铁锅扛不住，得有那种……怎么说呢，耐压材料之类的东西，高压锅？。”

许默盯着屏幕，脑子里转了几圈。

耐压容器……

他回复道：“容器我来想办法，等我消息。”

曲粒回了个好，又补了一句：“对了，爆炸后的残渣我收集了一点，涂在刀上试了，划破皮肤后兔子跑不出十步就倒。这玩意的潜力比我想的大得多，剩下的我就用来捕猎了？”

许默看着这条消息，回了个可以，关掉私聊界面

结束通讯，营地角落突然传来一阵凄厉刺耳的唧唧声。

方芸正拿着一块破布清理工作台的残局，她的指尖微微一抖。

一滴残存的腐血果汁液顺着桌面边缘滑落，精准地滴进了旁边那个装着小草的破陶盆里。

那是他们从洞穴深处挖出来的战利品。

暗红的毒液刚一接触土壤，原本萎靡的小草像是被注入了狂暴的肾上腺素。

主茎肉眼可见地膨胀、拉长，翠绿的叶片边缘迅速蔓延开一层浓稠的暗红。

许默瞬间抽出腰间的铁匕首，肌肉彻底绷紧，随时准备将这棵变异植物连根斩断。

但这株长相狰狞的植物并没有发动攻击。

Xu Mo told Quli the result.

There was silence for a few seconds, and he replied with a wry smile emoticon.

"Is there anyone else over there? I just said why I can't touch anyone around. It seems that I was thrown to the corner of the map."

"But my ability to survive until now is not entirely due to luck."

Xu Mo thought for a while and said: "People can't get through, but things can. The transaction interface is global. I will send you something through transactions. You can help me research it. You can put in whatever items you want, water, paper, leaves, whatever."

Quli said yes.

Xu Mo took out a [Rotten Blood Fruit] from the storage space.

Blue quality, highly toxic, but can be used as an anesthetic after treatment.

He used the system's transaction function to send the fruit to Quli, with the message: "Be careful, this thing is poisonous. Help me see if I can purify stable anesthetic ingredients."

The transaction box shows that the grains have been received.

About half an hour later, Quli sent a message, with a sense of excitement in the words: "Brother, the fruit you sent is strong! I just tried to heat the extraction in a stone pot, but the pot exploded and half of the kitchen wall was lost."

Xu Mo's mouth twitched: "Are you okay?"

"It's okay, I hid quickly. But I smelled the smell when it exploded. It had such a strong anesthetic effect that I almost fell asleep on the spot."

"The fruit will release powerful psychedelic ingredients at high temperatures, but it is also extremely unstable. If you can find a sealed container that can withstand high pressure, and heat the pulp at high temperature in the container so that the gas cannot escape, it should be able to purify a large amount of liquid anesthetic. Ordinary clay pots and iron pots cannot hold it, so you need to have that kind of... How should I say, something like a pressure-resistant material, a pressure cooker?"

Xu Mo stared at the screen and thought about it a few times.

Pressure-resistant container...

He replied: "I will figure out a solution for the container. Wait for my news."

Quli responded well and added: "By the way, I collected some of the residue after the explosion and tried it on a knife. After scratching the skin, the rabbit fell before it could run ten steps. The potential of this thing is much greater than I thought. I will use the rest for hunting?"

Xu Mo looked at the message, replied OK, and closed the private chat interface.

After ending the communication, a shrill and piercing chirping sound suddenly came from the corner of the camp.

Fang Yun was holding a rag to clean up the mess on the workbench, and her fingertips trembled slightly.

A drop of remaining rotten blood juice slid down the edge of the table and dripped accurately into the broken pottery basin filled with grass next to it.

That was the trophy they dug out from the depths of the cave.

As soon as the dark red venom touched the soil, the originally sluggish grass seemed to be injected with violent adrenaline.

The main stem swells and elongates visibly to the naked eye, and a thick dark red color quickly spreads around the edges of the emerald green leaves.

Xu Mo instantly pulled out the iron dagger from his waist, tensing his muscles completely, ready to cut off the mutant plant by the roots.

But the ferocious-looking plant did not attack.
